title: As super El Niño looms, Occidental Mindoro seeks solar water pumps for farmlands
summary: MAMBURAO, OCCIDENTAL MINDORO - Governor Eduardo Gadiano of Occidental Mindoro is pushing for the installation of solar-powered water pumps in farms to ensure a steady supply of irrigation water…

blocks.text: MAMBURAO, OCCIDENTAL MINDORO - Governor Eduardo Gadiano of Occidental Mindoro is pushing for the installation of solar-powered water pumps in farms to ensure a steady supply of irrigation water without relying on costly fuel, as the province braces for the potential impact of Super El Niño.
